paragraphs.text:
With a successful Navigate roll, you know where you are: go to 
234. If you fail the roll, you can wait for someone to come by, go 
to 256; or, you can walk for a day. If you walk, drink one day’s 
water. For North, go to 257; for East, go to 269; for South, go 
to 232; for West, go to 255.
(94, 232, 242, 255, 257, 269)
